panels.title: Compact Operator Banner
panels.description: Healthy: ACTIVE or IDLE WARM means the stack is ready. Attention: IDLE COLD or DEGRADED needs triage. Action Required: NO DATA means check Prometheus and exporters. No Data is not the same as 0.

options.content:
# Serving Cockpit

This dashboard separates **ACTIVE**, **IDLE WARM**, **IDLE COLD**, **DEGRADED**, and **NO DATA** so an idle platform does not look broken.

- **ACTIVE**: user request activity is present and readiness/scrape/GPU evidence is healthy.
- **IDLE WARM**: no user traffic, but runtime readiness/scrape/GPU headroom/OOM-restart evidence indicates the stack is warm and ready.
- **IDLE COLD**: no user traffic and readiness or residency evidence is absent.
- **DEGRADED**: one or more readiness, scrape, GPU, OOM, restart, error, latency, or capacity signals needs attention.
- **NO DATA**: Prometheus has no trustworthy runtime data; treat this separately from a numeric zero.

User-impact panels default to user routes only: `/v1/chat/completions|/v1/embeddings|/v1/risk/.*`. Control, observability, and docs routes are excluded by default.

panels.title: Overall Status
panels.description: Healthy: min overall_runtime_status is 1. Action Required: 0 means a runtime readiness path failed. No Runtime Data: metric absent or scrape down.

panels.title: User Requests in Window
panels.description: Healthy: gateway public entrypoint user request count is shown for ACTIVE. Attention: 0 requests can be IDLE WARM when readiness, scrape, GPU residency, and OOM absence are healthy. Action: this panel intentionally excludes risk-adapter backend activity to avoid double counting; use Prometheus Target Health to distinguish zero traffic from scrape failure.

panels.title: Model/Gateway Ready
panels.description: Healthy: gateway, risk adapter, and runtime readiness are 1. Action Required: any 0 means degraded serving. No Runtime Data: readiness metrics are missing.

panels.title: Prometheus Target Health
panels.description: Healthy: all expected critical scrape targets are present and up. Action Required: 0 means one is down or the expected target count is missing. No Data: Prometheus target metadata is absent. The expected critical target count is projected from gateway + risk-adapter + vLLM runtime targets + dcgm + cadvisor.

panels.title: Min GPU Headroom
panels.description: Healthy: selected-range minimum VRAM headroom stays above threshold. Attention: low range minimum during IDLE WARM indicates warm residency pressure. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: Container OOM / Restart Signals
panels.description: Healthy: 0 container OOM events and 0 container start-time changes when cAdvisor scrape health is green. Action Required: any value above 0 requires runtime/container triage. No Data: cAdvisor source metric absent; do not read No Data as 0.

panels.title: Warm Readiness Evidence
panels.description: Healthy: Evidence OK means readiness and expected scrape targets are present for IDLE WARM interpretation. Attention: Evidence Failed means readiness or scrape evidence failed. No Runtime Data: this is readiness/scrape evidence, not a full serving mode metric yet; readiness value freshness requires ai_readiness_last_checked_timestamp_seconds or synthetic probes. The expected scrape target count is projected from gateway + risk-adapter + vLLM runtime targets + dcgm + cadvisor.

panels.title: Gateway Ready
panels.description: Healthy: gateway readiness remains up. Action Required: drops indicate gateway not ready. No Runtime Data: readiness metric absent.

panels.title: Risk Adapter Ready
panels.description: Healthy: risk adapter readiness remains up. Action Required: drops affect risk path. No Runtime Data: readiness metric absent.

panels.title: vLLM Runtime Scrape
panels.description: Healthy: vLLM scrape is up by model/runtime_service. Action Required: any down runtime can cold-start or fail requests. No Data: target missing.

panels.title: DCGM Exporter Up
panels.description: Healthy: GPU exporter is up. Action Required: GPU residency cannot be trusted when down. No Data: target missing.

panels.title: cAdvisor Up
panels.description: Healthy: container exporter is up. Attention: restart/container resource panels depend on it. No Data: target missing.

panels.title: Request Rate by Service/Route
panels.description: Healthy: gateway public activity and risk-adapter backend activity are separated by service label. Attention: service-level activity can differ from User Requests in Window because backend risk-adapter metrics are included here. No Data: gateway/risk-adapter request metric absent; control/docs/observability routes are excluded.

panels.title: TTFT p50/p95/p99
panels.description: Healthy: TTFT percentiles stay within target. Attention: p95/p99 rising before error rate often means runtime pressure. No Data: streaming histogram absent.

panels.title: HTTP Handler Latency p95/p99
panels.description: Healthy: gateway HTTP handler latency for user routes stays within target. Attention: this is request handler duration and may not equal full StreamingResponse duration; use TTFT here and Chat API Deep Dive for full streaming duration. No Data: gateway histogram absent.

panels.title: Error Request Rate by Service/Route/Status
panels.description: Healthy: low 5xx and expected 4xx request rate by service, route, and status. Action Required: 5xx request rate on user routes. No Data: gateway/risk-adapter request counter absent. This is a request rate, not an error ratio.

panels.title: Client Disconnect Rate
panels.description: Healthy: low disconnect rate. Attention: rising disconnects may indicate slow TTFT or client timeout. No Data: streaming disconnect metric absent.

panels.title: Synthetic Probe Backlog
panels.description: Action: synthetic probe success, duration, and last-success metrics are backlog for this phase. No Data is expected until instrumentation exists. Attention: IDLE WARM confidence requires readiness freshness or synthetic probe evidence.

options.content:
## Backlog

No synthetic probe or active-request metric is added in this phase. Track these as instrumentation backlog before promoting them to status cards: `ai_gateway_active_requests`, `ai_runtime_active_requests`, synthetic probe success/duration/last-success, per-model readiness, composite serving mode, readiness freshness, and critical metric freshness.


IDLE WARM confidence requires readiness freshness or synthetic probe evidence; current readiness values are not freshness metrics.

panels.title: vLLM Queue Depth
panels.description: Healthy: queue remains near zero. Attention: rising queue before latency impact indicates runtime saturation. No Runtime Data: vLLM metric absent.

panels.title: KV Cache Pressure
panels.description: Healthy: KV cache pressure below budget. Attention: sustained high pressure increases OOM risk. No Runtime Data: vLLM KV metric absent.

panels.title: Token Throughput
panels.description: Healthy: throughput follows traffic. Attention: throughput without user traffic may be background activity or scrape artifact. No Runtime Data: vLLM token metric absent.

panels.title: GPU Utilization
panels.description: Healthy: idle warm can have low utilization while memory remains resident. Attention: high utilization without traffic needs review. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: GPU Power
panels.description: Healthy: power follows runtime load and warm residency. Attention: high sustained power while idle may need capacity review. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: Active Requests Backlog
panels.description: Action: active request panels are intentionally excluded until ai_gateway_active_requests and ai_runtime_active_requests are instrumented. No Data is expected for this phase.

options.content:
## Backlog

No synthetic probe or active-request metric is added in this phase. Track these as instrumentation backlog before promoting them to status cards: `ai_gateway_active_requests`, `ai_runtime_active_requests`, synthetic probe success/duration/last-success, per-model readiness, composite serving mode, readiness freshness, and critical metric freshness.

panels.title: Current GPU Memory Used
panels.description: Healthy: warm residency is visible even at idle. Attention: memory above budget may reduce headroom. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: Max GPU Memory Used in Range
panels.description: Healthy: peak VRAM stays within budget. Attention: peak near total VRAM indicates OOM risk. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: Current GPU Headroom
panels.description: Healthy: current headroom is above operating threshold. Attention: low headroom during IDLE WARM means warm residency is expensive. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: Min GPU Headroom in Range
panels.description: Healthy: range minimum stays above threshold. Action Required: near-zero minimum suggests imminent or recent OOM pressure. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: VRAM Used vs Budget
panels.description: Healthy: used VRAM remains under budget lines. Attention: approaching 40-43GiB budget. No Runtime Data: DCGM memory metrics absent.

panels.title: Max KV Cache Pressure in Range
panels.description: Healthy: max KV pressure stays below budget. Attention: high pressure can precede OOM. No Runtime Data: vLLM KV metric absent.

panels.title: GPU Temperature
panels.description: Healthy: temperature is within operating range. Attention: rising temperature can throttle runtime. No Runtime Data: GPU exporter absent.

panels.title: Container OOM / Restart Signals Detail
panels.description: Healthy: 0 container OOM events and 0 container start-time changes in the selected range when cAdvisor scrape health is green. Action Required: any event requires drill-down. No Data: cAdvisor source metric absence must not be read as zero.

panels.title: Prometheus Target Health Detail
panels.description: Healthy: all critical scrape targets remain up. Action Required: target down breaks evidence chain. No Data: Prometheus target data missing.

panels.title: Scrape Target Count
panels.description: Healthy: expected target count is present. Attention: count changes after config edits. No Data: Prometheus up series missing.

panels.title: Scrape Up Count
panels.description: Healthy: up count equals the projected expected critical target count. Action Required: lower up count means scrape failure or missing target. No Data: Prometheus up series missing. The expected critical target count is projected from gateway + risk-adapter + vLLM runtime targets + dcgm + cadvisor.

panels.title: Critical Metric Freshness Backlog
panels.description: Action: critical metric freshness is backlog for ai_critical_metric_freshness_seconds. No Data is expected until instrumentation exists; do not replace it with 0.
